e.title: MS AI-Powered Claims Automation
e.summary: 微软保险理赔自动化加速器（19★，MIT）：Azure AI 理赔处理——文档类型识别/字段提取/智能客服（官方参考架构）
e.summary_en: Microsoft insurance claims automation accelerator (19★, MIT): Azure AI claim processing — document type recognition/field extraction/intelligent agent (official reference)
e.summary_hk: 微軟保險理賠自動化加速器（19★，MIT）：Azure AI 理賠處理——文檔類型識別/字段提取/智能客服（官方參考架構）
e.body: AI-Powered Insurance Claims Automation Accelerator（微软 MSUS Azure Accelerators，19★，MIT）是保险理赔自动化的 Azure 参考架构：AI 识别文档类型、提取字段并推送下游应用——智能客服（语音激活理赔）、多通道文档上传（驾照/保险卡/估价单/损坏照片）——显著减少人工处理。对 RIAA：保险理赔自动化的官方参考——[[claimpilot-harness]]（理赔 agent 测试）的工程实现层；文档识别/字段提取（理赔 MCP 类应用）；智能客服（[[insurance-support-agent]] 架构）；Azure 生态（与 AWS/Bedrock 对照）；与 [[hcls-agent-skills]]、[[mongodb-rag-insurance]] 配套；适合保险理赔自动化与云架构方向。
e.body_en: The AI-Powered Insurance Claims Automation Accelerator (Microsoft MSUS Azure Accelerators, 19★, MIT) is an Azure reference architecture for insurance claims automation: AI recognises document types, extracts fields and pushes data to downstream applications — intelligent agents (voice-activated claim filing), multi-channel document upload (driver's licence/insurance card/estimate/damage photos) — significantly reducing manual effort. For RIAA: the official reference for claims automation — the engineering-implementation layer of [[claimpilot-harness]] (claims agent testing); document recognition/field extraction (claims MCP applications); intelligent agents (the [[insurance-support-agent]] architecture); Azure ecosystem (contrast with AWS/Bedrock); pairs with [[hcls-agent-skills]] and [[mongodb-rag-insurance]]; suits claims automation and cloud architecture.
e.body_hk: AI-Powered Insurance Claims Automation Accelerator（微軟 MSUS Azure Accelerators，19★，MIT）是保險理賠自動化的 Azure 參考架構：AI 識別文檔類型、提取字段並推送下游應用——智能客服（語音激活理賠）、多通道文檔上傳（駕照/保險卡/估價單/損壞照片）——顯著減少人工處理。對 RIAA：保險理賠自動化的官方參考——[[claimpilot-harness]]（理賠 agent 測試）的工程實現層；文檔識別/字段提取（理賠 MCP 類應用）；智能客服（[[insurance-support-agent]] 架構）；Azure 生態（與 AWS/Bedrock 對照）；與 [[hcls-agent-skills]]、[[mongodb-rag-insurance]] 配套；適合保險理賠自動化與雲架構方向。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：微软官方加速器（Azure 理赔自动化），未实测
